fato_historico: 1989: Space Shuttle program: STS-28 Mission: Space Shuttle Columbia takes off on a secret five-day military mission.
energia_do_dia: Today, your inner light mirrors the cosmic journey of a vessel soaring into the velvet night. It is a good time to consider what secret missions your soul is currently planning. You may find that your ambition reaches new heights, allowing you to orbit your dreams with grace and a renewed sense of bold, golden confidence.
frase_do_dia: The stars align to illuminate the secret paths within your own brave heart.
significado_numero: The infinite loop of cosmic abundance and enduring personal power.
conselho: Trust your inner compass and launch your brightest ideas into the world today.
